about: Models for the shared-read test, as run 1 actually ran them (2026-10-30, Eshaan's Mac Studio, 36 GB): 4-bit MLX builds from Hugging Face served by mlx_lm.server behind an Ollama-shaped stand-in on port 11434 (see the plan, 'How run 1 ran'). Thinking is turned off with chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false, which MLX reads from the chat template. gb is a rough in-memory size for the memory guard. Change models here, not in code, then run `scripts/shared_read.py freeze` before the next run.

reader.note: The preregistered fallback reader. Qwen3.8 27B (the first choice) left too little room: the guard saw 19.6 to 22.9 GB free against about 23 GB needed.

ants.note: Gemma 4 E2B. Often writes LaTeX like \cap inside its JSON answers, which parser 1 rejects.
Replaced LFM3 1.7B, which no released mlx-lm can run yet. LFM2.5 2.6B was passed over because its thinking can't be turned off.
